name: Buenos Aires Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars only (backfill; not independently verified). 2025-2026: exchange_calendars + exchange_publications; 2025-04-17 (Holy Thursday, a non-working day) is unconfirmed with recheck_date 2026-12-31: the registry trades it, both libraries close it, BYMA's calendar page now serves 2026 only and no BYMA communique for Semana Santa 2025 was found; a market-data history (rava.com, BYMA share, April 2025) lists 19 sessions and none on 17 April, which points to a closure but is not BYMA's word. It is settled by BYMA's 2025 calendar or its April 2025 communique (byma.com.ar/comunicados) (4d.1). 2027-2029: exchange_calendars + standing pattern; BYMA's calendar page shows 2026 only (read 2026-11-21), so Holy Thursday 2027-2029 (a non-working day, the registry trades) is a prediction (4d.1). Caution: for 2025-2029 the registry disagrees with exchange_calendars on 18 days, 14 of them triaged as library errors (the other 4 as unpublished) in docs/DIVERGENCE.md (Argentina moves some holidays by decree and adds bridge days), so the 2010-2024 backfill is likely to carry similar errors; pandas_market_calendars mirrors exchange_calendars and cannot catch them.
